notes.title: Grades & Assessment
notes.onboardSubtitle: Set up your school's grading system
notes.onboardDescSeq: This module lets you enter the grades of each sequence, automatically compute term and annual averages, and generate your students' report cards.
notes.onboardDescTri: This module lets you enter the grades of each term, automatically compute term and annual averages, and generate your students' report cards.
notes.stepStructureSingle: 1 assessment per term, 3 terms per year. The average of the 3 terms gives the annual grade.
notes.stepStructureSeq: 6 sequences (2 per term), 3 terms per year. The average of the 2 sequences gives the term grade. The average of the 3 terms gives the annual grade.
notes.stepCoeffDesc: Each subject is weighted by its weekly teaching hours. E.g. Mathematics (6h) counts more than PE (2h) in the overall average.
notes.stepBulletinsDesc: The director validates and sends the report cards. Parents receive them in their space. Each report card shows the rank, average, comment and end-of-year decision.

mia.privateLessonHint: MIAPO generates an exercise tailored to your level and guides you step by step (method, hints, explanation).
mia.rtReviseHint: Pick a subject: MIAPO suggests revision methods suited to it, grounded in cognitive-science research.
mia.rtImportCourses: Import my courses / a document to revise
mia.rtChooseType: How do you want to revise {subject}?
mia.rth_flashcards: Front/back spaced over time: memory that lasts.
mia.rth_explain: Explain in your own words; MIAPO spots the gaps (Feynman method).
mia.rth_interleave: Mixed exercise types: learn to pick the right method.
mia.rth_dictee: Writing what you hear sharpens spelling and attention.
mia.rth_redaction: Write it out: MIAPO checks both content AND form.
mia.rth_mindmap: Link ideas in a diagram: dual coding aids recall.
mia.rtSeed_explain: I want to revise {subject} (level {niveau}) by explaining it to you myself. Pick an important concept, ask me to explain it in my own words, then correct and complete like a tutor (Feynman method). Ask one question at a time.
mia.rtSeed_interleave: Have me revise {subject} (level {niveau}) with mixed problems: give me a series of different exercise types, one at a time, correct each one and explain how to recognise the right method.
mia.rtSeed_dictee: Give me a {subject} dictation suited to level {niveau}: provide a short text sentence by sentence (I write it), then correct my spelling and grammar mistakes and explain them. One sentence at a time.
mia.rtSeed_mindmap: Help me build a mind map of {subject} (level {niveau}): propose the central concept and main branches, then quiz me so I fill in the sub-branches one by one.
mia.requestRevisionHint: Pick a subject: it will appear in {name}'s “To review”, and they will work on it with MIAPO. You track, {name} revises.
